about: The freeze of an addition to demo/shared-runs' first study: every job of its sweep run alone on other machines. Committed before any of the three named machines ran the sweep alone. A change is a new freeze, with its reason.
made_after: the first study was run and judged; each of the two AVX-512 machines had already run 20 of these jobs afresh and found them the same

rules.E1: passes when every added machine ran every job of the plan alone and each came to the same outcome, step and SHA-256 as the first baseline; a machine that ran fewer is not tested; one job otherwise fails
rules.E2: measured, no threshold: the jobs run in full, from their start, on each kind of processor, and on how many kinds each job was

said_beforehand: E1 is expected to pass for the two AVX-512 machines. Of the phone nothing is known, and its NumPy is linked to another linear-algebra library, so it differs from the rest in two things.
